note: Owner-added entry, NOT from the PDF. On 2026-10-26 the owner asked for a fashion problem that the Addendum 2 pack lacks: people ask the price in DM, then go quiet. Ideas 1 and 2 are the owner's own words (idea 2 with the time word taken out). This file is merged by solutions.load(), so a rebuild of the packs from the PDF (scripts/build_industry_solutions.py) cannot erase it.

problems.words: Many people ask the price in DM every day and after I tell the price there is no reply. Roz bohat log DM mein price poochte hain, price batane ke baad reply nahi aata
quick_ideas: Send a clear photo, the size chart and a line about delivery together with the rate, so they need not ask again.
Message the people who asked the rate and went quiet with a short note on the most liked pair, so the talk starts again.

workzap_build.text: a reply with photo, size chart and delivery in one message, plus a gentle follow-up for people who went quiet and agreed to hear from you.

problems.ask_first: Do they go quiet right after you tell the price?
problems.free_stops: How the reply and the follow-up are set up is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Add one line saying what the rate includes, so people do not leave over a number alone.
Look at the enquiries that did turn into orders and copy what those replies had in common, so the next reply starts from what worked.
